casks.install:
set -euo pipefail
arch="$(uname -m)"
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/wsp-cask-XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
case "$arch" in x86_64) a=x86_64 sha=6c774c76793eedd501150b59da653610fbe3eaac169e822965b722de75a2f001 ;; aarch64) a=arm sha=e50ea0141a027d5118d7dd011d2870e706466dc0fc437d95cae86a14e0d871bc ;; *) echo "Error: unsupported arch: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac

ver='586.0.0'

ln -sf /opt/google-cloud-sdk/bin/bq /usr/local/bin/bq
echo "WSP_ROAD release $pkg $sha $ver"
